rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Exposes a single frappe_api tool for making HTTP requests to Frappe/ERPNext REST API endpoints under the /api path. Supports all standard HTTP methods with configurable query parameters, request bodies, and headers while automatically handling token-based authentication via environment variables. Useful for integrating AI assistants with Frappe-based systems like ERPNext.
